name: Soyuz TM-21
about: Soyuz TM-21 (1995-010A), a crewed vehicle (7K-STM), launched 1995 Mar 14. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1995 Apr 13), held fixed
docked to S17845; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
